{
  "dataset_name": "naticusdroid",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "network_activity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite score representing the breadth of network and internet access requested by the application.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a dense severity measure of network capability, helping the linear SVM establish a margin based on overall network access rather than individual sparse flags.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_internet + android_permission_access_network_state + android_permission_access_wifi_state + android_permission_change_wifi_state + android_permission_change_network_state"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_risk_telephony_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of telephony and SMS permissions, which are frequently abused for premium SMS fraud or data exfiltration.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates high-risk telephony features into a single continuous-like dimension, allowing the SVM to apply a unified weight to telephony abuse potential.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_read_phone_state + android_permission_call_phone + android_permission_read_sms + android_permission_send_sms + android_permission_receive_sms"
    },
    {
      "name": "location_tracking_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures the intensity of location tracking capabilities requested by the app.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "privacy_exposure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a smooth gradient of location tracking severity, improving the linear model's ability to penalize excessive tracking.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_access_fine_location + android_permission_access_coarse_location + android_permission_access_mock_location"
    },
    {
      "name": "storage_and_media_access",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Evaluates the extent to which the app can access local files, camera, and microphone.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces dimensionality by grouping related media and storage permissions, providing a more robust signal for the SVM decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_read_external_storage + android_permission_write_external_storage + android_permission_camera + android_permission_record_audio"
    },
    {
      "name": "system_persistence_and_stealth",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Calculates a score based on permissions that allow an app to run at startup, stay awake, draw over other apps, and monitor tasks.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "behavioral_analysis",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights persistence mechanisms commonly used by background services, offering a strong linear projection for behavioral risk.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_receive_boot_completed + android_permission_wake_lock + android_permission_system_alert_window + android_permission_get_tasks"
    },
    {
      "name": "personal_data_exposure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of permissions related to reading or modifying user contacts, accounts, and calendar events.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "privacy_exposure",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Consolidates personal data access into a single severity metric, which is highly effective for linear models assessing privacy risks.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_read_contacts + android_permission_write_contacts + android_permission_get_accounts + android_permission_read_calendar"
    },
    {
      "name": "launcher_manipulation_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Counts permissions related to installing/uninstalling shortcuts and modifying launcher badges.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "adware_indicators",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures aggressive UI manipulation tactics often seen in adware, providing a clear numerical feature for the SVM to weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "com_android_launcher_permission_install_shortcut + com_android_launcher_permission_uninstall_shortcut + com_sonyericsson_home_permission_broadcast_badge + com_sec_android_provider_badge_permission_read + com_sec_android_provider_badge_permission_write"
    },
    {
      "name": "telephony_to_network_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of telephony/SMS permissions to basic network permissions, smoothed to avoid division by zero.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Identifies apps that request heavy telephony access without corresponding network needs, creating a non-linear interaction feature that is linearly separable for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(android_permission_read_phone_state + android_permission_send_sms + android_permission_receive_sms) / (android_permission_internet + android_permission_access_network_state + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "suspicious_behavior_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of highly sensitive permissions such as sending SMS, reading phone state, drawing over apps, and requesting package installations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a pre-calculated, weighted severity score that directly aligns with the margin-maximization objective of a linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "2.0 * android_permission_send_sms + 1.5 * android_permission_read_phone_state + 1.5 * android_permission_system_alert_window + 2.0 * android_permission_request_install_packages"
    },
    {
      "name": "hardware_control_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures the extent of hardware control requested, including bluetooth, camera, vibrate, and flashlight.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups miscellaneous hardware controls into a denser feature, reducing sparsity and improving model generalization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "android_permission_bluetooth + android_permission_camera + android_permission_vibrate + android_permission_flashlight"
    },
    {
      "name": "suspicious_permission_synergy",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of whether the app requests a combination of permissions that are rarely needed together in benign apps (e.g., SMS + Internet + Boot Completed), indicating potential botnet or spyware behavior.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures complex, multi-permission interactions that a linear model cannot easily learn from raw binary flags alone.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "adware_monetization_potential",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the app's likelihood to aggressively monetize via ads or unwanted shortcuts, based on the presence of billing, launcher shortcuts, and system alert windows.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous risk score for adware-like behavior, allowing the SVM to separate aggressive monetization tactics from standard app functionality.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
